ADMIN.name: Admin
ADMIN.description: Platform administrator: adds and manages companies (doesn't see their employees).

COMPANY.name: Company
COMPANY.description: Company administrator: manages its employees, validators, and verification policy.

EMPLOYEE.name: Employee
EMPLOYEE.description: Employee: enrolls their face and identifies with their face or their QR code.

VALIDATOR.name: Validator
VALIDATOR.description: Identity validator: a tablet or phone that identifies the company's employees.

FACE.name: Face
FACE.description: The person looks at the camera; the search covers the whole staff

QR.name: QR
QR.description: Dynamic code on the employee's phone; it works only once

QR_FACE.name: QR + face
QR_FACE.description: Scans their QR and confirms the face belongs to its owner

QR_OR_FACE.name: QR or face
QR_OR_FACE.description: The operator chooses for each identification: QR badge or face recognition.

QR.name: QR only
QR.description: Scans the QR code on the employee's badge (printed or on their phone).

FACE.name: Face only
FACE.description: Recognizes the employee by their face among the whole staff, no badge needed.

QR_AND_FACE.name: QR and face
QR_AND_FACE.description: Maximum security: scans the QR and the face must belong to its owner.

NOT_ENROLLED.name: Not enrolled
NOT_ENROLLED.description: The employee hasn't enrolled their face yet. They'll be asked to enroll at their next sign-in.
NOT_ENROLLED.employee_note: You'll enroll your face when you sign in

PENDING_REVIEW.name: Pending validation
PENDING_REVIEW.description: The employee enrolled their face and is waiting for your validation.

APPROVED.name: Validated
APPROVED.description: They can identify themselves with their face or QR code.

REJECTED.name: Rejected
REJECTED.description: The employee must enroll their face again.
REJECTED.employee_note: You need to enroll your face again

APPROVED.name: Accepted
APPROVED.description: The company accepted the face enrollment.

REJECTED.name: Rejected
REJECTED.description: The company rejected the face enrollment.

PENDING.name: Awaiting approval
PENDING.description: The validator signed in on this device and is waiting for the company's approval.

APPROVED.name: Approved
APPROVED.description: The company approved the device: the validator can operate on it.

REJECTED.name: Rejected
REJECTED.description: The company didn't approve the device.

REVOKED.name: Revoked
REVOKED.description: The company withdrew its approval: its sessions were closed.

EMPLOYEES_READ.name: Employees
EMPLOYEES_READ.description: Read employees (GET /employees and /employees/{id}): job and contact details, status, and face enrollment. Never photos or biometric data.

ATTENDANCE_READ.name: Identifications
ATTENDANCE_READ.description: Read the identification log (GET /attendance): who, when, with which method, at which validator, and the result.

VALIDATORS_READ.name: Validators
VALIDATORS_READ.description: Read the identity validators (GET /validators): name, mode, address, and status.

ACTIVE.name: Active
ACTIVE.description: The key gives access to the API with its permissions.

EXPIRED.name: Expired
EXPIRED.description: It reached its expiration date: it no longer gives access.

REVOKED.name: Revoked
REVOKED.description: The company revoked it (or rotated it): it no longer gives access.

LIVENESS_FAILED.name: Liveness check failed
LIVENESS_FAILED.message: The requested movement wasn't detected. Try again.

LIVENESS_MISMATCH.name: Captures of different people
LIVENESS_MISMATCH.message: The captures don't belong to the same person. Try again.

FACE_NOT_REGISTERED.name: No validated face
FACE_NOT_REGISTERED.message: The employee's face hasn't been validated by the company yet

EMPTY_GALLERY.name: No enrolled faces
EMPTY_GALLERY.message: There are no employees with a validated identity in this company yet

AMBIGUOUS_MATCH.name: Resembles several people
AMBIGUOUS_MATCH.message: Couldn't tell who the person is with enough certainty. Try again in good lighting.

INCONSISTENT_MATCH.name: Inconclusive captures
INCONSISTENT_MATCH.message: The captures don't match a single person. Try again.

REVOKED.name: QR replaced
REVOKED.description: The employee generated another code or the company invalidated this one.
REVOKED.message: This QR code has been replaced. Ask the employee to show the current code on their phone.

EXPIRED.name: QR expired
EXPIRED.description: The dynamic code is past its validity (or the time to confirm the face ran out).
EXPIRED.message: The QR code expired. Ask the employee to show the updated code on their phone.

SPOOF_DETECTED.name: Possible photo or screen
SPOOF_DETECTED.description: Anti-spoofing detected a printed photo, a screen, or a video.
SPOOF_DETECTED.message: Couldn't confirm that you're a person in front of the camera. Try again.

IMAGE_NOT_FROM_CAMERA.name: Image not from the camera
IMAGE_NOT_FROM_CAMERA.description: The image carries metadata from a camera or an editor: it's an uploaded file, not a live capture.
IMAGE_NOT_FROM_CAMERA.message: The image doesn't come from the app's camera. Take the capture live in front of the camera.

STATIC_CAPTURE.name: Still photo
STATIC_CAPTURE.description: The captures in the attempt are identical: a real person never produces two identical frames.
STATIC_CAPTURE.message: The captures are identical, like a still photo. Stand in front of the camera and try again.

REPLAY_DETECTED.name: Reused capture
REPLAY_DETECTED.description: The capture had already been received: it's a resubmission of a saved capture.
REPLAY_DETECTED.message: This capture was already used. Take a new one in front of the camera.

CAPTURE_INCONSISTENT.name: Captures from different takes
CAPTURE_INCONSISTENT.description: The captures don't come from the same camera, or the face changed size or position in an impossible way.
CAPTURE_INCONSISTENT.message: The captures don't seem to be from the same take. Don't switch cameras or move away during the process.

VIRTUAL_CAMERA.name: Virtual camera
VIRTUAL_CAMERA.description: The camera used is a program that can stream a video or a photo instead of the real camera.
VIRTUAL_CAMERA.message: Virtual cameras aren't allowed. Use the device's camera.

CHALLENGE_TOO_FAST.name: Turn too fast
CHALLENGE_TOO_FAST.description: The capture of the head turn arrived sooner than a person takes to turn their head.
CHALLENGE_TOO_FAST.message: The turn was captured too quickly. Follow the on-screen instruction and try again.

ALREADY_USED.name: QR already used
ALREADY_USED.description: Each dynamic code works only once: this one had already been scanned.
ALREADY_USED.message: This QR code was already used. Ask the employee to show the new code on their phone.

STATIC_QR.name: Printed QR (no longer valid)
STATIC_QR.description: Fixed code from the previous version (printed or downloaded badge).
STATIC_QR.message: Printed QR codes are no longer valid. The employee must show their dynamic code from their phone.

FLASH_MISMATCH.name: The face didn't reflect the flash
FLASH_MISMATCH.description: Suspicious attempt: the screen colors weren't reflected on the face (injected or generated video).
FLASH_MISMATCH.message: Couldn't confirm that you're in front of the screen. Look straight at the camera and try again.

FLASH_INCONCLUSIVE.name: Flash not measurable
FLASH_INCONCLUSIVE.description: Too much ambient light: the screen colors didn't show on the face.
FLASH_INCONCLUSIVE.message: Couldn't detect the screen's reflection on your face. Avoid direct sunlight, turn up the screen brightness, and try again.

FLASH_FLAT.name: Flat flash
FLASH_FLAT.message: Couldn't confirm that you're in front of the screen. Look straight at the camera and try again.

REPLAY_PERCEPTUAL.name: Capture nearly identical to another
REPLAY_PERCEPTUAL.message: This capture was already used. Take a new one in front of the camera.

KNOWN_ATTACK.name: Known attack
KNOWN_ATTACK.message: Couldn't confirm your identity. Try again in good lighting, facing the screen.

RISK_DENIED.name: Critical risk
RISK_DENIED.message: Couldn't confirm your identity. Try again in good lighting, facing the screen.

STEP_UP_REQUIRED.name: Extra step requested
STEP_UP_REQUIRED.message: For security, complete one more step of the liveness check

TURN_LEFT.name: Turn left
TURN_LEFT.instruction: Slowly turn your head to your left

TURN_RIGHT.name: Turn right
TURN_RIGHT.instruction: Slowly turn your head to your right

LOOK_UP.name: Look up
LOOK_UP.instruction: Raise your chin a little and look up

LOOK_DOWN.name: Look down
LOOK_DOWN.instruction: Lower your chin a little and look down

MOVE_CLOSER.name: Move closer to the camera
MOVE_CLOSER.instruction: Bring your face closer to the camera

CA_BN.name: Business Number
CA_BN.description: 9 digits, with or without the program account (e.g., RT0001)

CO_NIT.name: Tax Identification Number
CO_NIT.description: 7 to 16 digits, ending with the check digit

AR_CUIT.name: Unique Tax Identification Code
AR_CUIT.description: 11 digits, ending with the check digit

CL_RUT.name: Unique Tax Roll
CL_RUT.description: 8 to 9 characters: the number and its check digit (0 to 9 or K)

BR_CNPJ.name: National Registry of Legal Entities
BR_CNPJ.description: 14 characters: 12 letters or digits and 2 check digits

GB_CRN.name: Company registration number
GB_CRN.description: 8 characters: 8 digits, or 2 letters and 6 digits

FR_SIRET.name: SIRET establishment number
FR_SIRET.description: 14 digits: the SIREN plus 5 for the establishment

PERSON_MISMATCH.name: The person in the photo isn't the employee

SPOOFING.name: Spoofing detected (photo of a photo or a screen)

STANDARD.name: Standard
STANDARD.description: Rejects when most of the captures look like a photo, a screen, or a video. Recommended for most cameras.

HIGH.name: High
HIGH.description: More sensitive: rejects on moderate signs of a photo or a screen. In low light or with low-quality cameras it may ask to repeat the capture.

MAXIMUM.name: Maximum
MAXIMUM.description: Rejects if a single capture looks like a photo or a screen. Requires good lighting and a quality camera.

OFF.name: Off
OFF.description: The screen doesn't flash colors during the liveness check.

OBSERVE.name: Measure only
OBSERVE.description: The screen flashes colors and how the face reflects them is measured, without blocking anyone. Use it to calibrate with real captures before requiring it.

ENFORCE.name: Required
ENFORCE.description: The face must reflect the screen's colors: an injected or generated video doesn't. In direct sunlight it may ask to try again. Turn it on after calibrating.

LOGOUT.name: Signed out
LOGOUT.message: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.

LOGOUT_ALL.name: Signed out on all devices
LOGOUT_ALL.description: The person signed out on all their devices.
LOGOUT_ALL.message: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.

REVOKED_BY_USER.name: Closed from another session
REVOKED_BY_USER.description: The person closed this session from their list of active sessions.
REVOKED_BY_USER.message: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.

PASSWORD_CHANGED.name: Password changed
PASSWORD_CHANGED.description: The password changed: the other sessions are closed.
PASSWORD_CHANGED.message: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.

PASSWORD_RESET.name: Password reset
PASSWORD_RESET.message: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.

ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED.name: Account deactivated
ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED.description: The account (or the job at that company) was deactivated.
ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED.message: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.

COMPANY_DEACTIVATED.name: Company deactivated
COMPANY_DEACTIVATED.description: The company was deactivated: its staff's sessions are closed.
COMPANY_DEACTIVATED.message: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.

EMPLOYEE_REMOVED.name: Removed from the company
EMPLOYEE_REMOVED.description: The person is no longer an employee of that company.
EMPLOYEE_REMOVED.message: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.

SIGNED_IN_ELSEWHERE.name: Signed in on another device
SIGNED_IN_ELSEWHERE.description: A new sign-in replaced this one (only one active session per person).
SIGNED_IN_ELSEWHERE.message: Someone signed in with your account on another device. You can only have one active session at a time.

REFRESH_REUSE_DETECTED.name: Possible session theft
REFRESH_REUSE_DETECTED.description: An already used refresh token was presented: theft is assumed and the session is closed.
REFRESH_REUSE_DETECTED.message: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.

LOCATION_POLICY_CHANGED.name: Allowed location changed
LOCATION_POLICY_CHANGED.description: The company required or changed the location where the validator operates.
LOCATION_POLICY_CHANGED.message: Your company changed the location where you can operate. Sign in again at that location.

DEVICE_REVOKED.name: Device revoked
DEVICE_REVOKED.description: The company withdrew its approval of the validator's device.
DEVICE_REVOKED.message: Your company withdrew its approval of this device. Ask them to approve it again.

COMPANY_SUSPENDED.name: Company suspended
COMPANY_SUSPENDED.description: The platform administrator suspended the company (non-payment or a manual decision).
COMPANY_SUSPENDED.message: Your company is suspended. Contact the platform administrator to reactivate it.

ACCOUNT_DELETED.name: Account deleted
ACCOUNT_DELETED.description: The account or its company was deleted: its sessions are closed.
ACCOUNT_DELETED.message: Your account was deleted. Contact your company if you think this is a mistake.

INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT.name: Format not allowed
INVALID_IMAGE_FORMAT.message: Image format not allowed (use JPEG, PNG, or WEBP)

IMAGE_TOO_SMALL.name: Image too small
IMAGE_TOO_SMALL.message: The image must be at least {min_dimension}px on each side

IMAGE_TOO_LARGE.name: Image too large
IMAGE_TOO_LARGE.message: The image is larger than {max_dimension}px on one of its sides

INVALID_IMAGE.name: Invalid image
INVALID_IMAGE.message: Couldn't process the image. Take another photo.

NO_FACE.name: No face
NO_FACE.message: No face was detected in the image

MULTIPLE_FACES.name: Several people
MULTIPLE_FACES.message: More than one person was detected. Only one face should appear.

LOW_DETECTION_SCORE.name: Unclear face
LOW_DETECTION_SCORE.message: Your face isn't clearly visible. Look straight at the camera.

FACE_TOO_SMALL.name: Face too far
FACE_TOO_SMALL.message: Your face is too far away. Move closer to the camera.

FACE_CUT_OFF.name: Face cut off
FACE_CUT_OFF.message: Your face is cut off. Center it in the camera.

POSE_NOT_FRONTAL.name: Head turned
POSE_NOT_FRONTAL.message: Look straight at the camera without turning your head

POSE_TILTED.name: Head tilted
POSE_TILTED.message: Keep your head straight, without tilting it

POSE_PITCH.name: Head up or down
POSE_PITCH.message: Look straight at the camera without raising or lowering your head

TOO_DARK.name: Too dark
TOO_DARK.message: The image is too dark. Find better lighting.

TOO_BRIGHT.name: Overexposed
TOO_BRIGHT.message: The image is overexposed. Avoid direct light.

TOO_BLURRY.name: Blurry
TOO_BLURRY.message: The image is blurry. Hold still.

ACCESSORIES_DETECTED.name: Accessories
ACCESSORIES_DETECTED.description: {accessories} is built from the phrases (phrase) in the accessories catalog.

SPOOF_DETECTED.name: Possible spoofing
SPOOF_DETECTED.message: Couldn't confirm that you're a person in front of the camera. Avoid reflections and screens, and use your real face (not a photo or video).

ENROLL_INCONSISTENT.name: Inconsistent captures
ENROLL_INCONSISTENT.message: The photos don't match each other. Repeat the capture with only one person, facing forward, in good lighting.

LIVENESS_REQUIRED.name: Liveness check missing
LIVENESS_REQUIRED.message: Complete the liveness check to continue

CHALLENGE_INVALID.name: Challenge expired
CHALLENGE_INVALID.message: The verification challenge expired or isn't valid. Try again.

LIVENESS_FAILED.name: Liveness check failed
LIVENESS_FAILED.message: The requested movement wasn't detected. Try again.

LIVENESS_MISMATCH.name: Another person in the challenge
LIVENESS_MISMATCH.message: The captures don't belong to the same person. Try again.

FACE_NOT_REGISTERED.name: No face enrollment
FACE_NOT_REGISTERED.description: The employee tries to verify without having enrolled their face.
FACE_NOT_REGISTERED.message: You don't have a face enrollment. Contact your company.

FACE_SERVICE_BUSY.name: Face engine busy
FACE_SERVICE_BUSY.message: There are many recognition requests right now. Try again in a few seconds.

FACE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.name: Face engine unavailable
FACE_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.message: Face recognition is temporarily unavailable. You can identify with your QR code.

FACE_PROCESSING_ERROR.name: Face engine error
FACE_PROCESSING_ERROR.message: Couldn't process the face right now. Try again.

IMAGE_NOT_FROM_CAMERA.name: Image not from the camera
IMAGE_NOT_FROM_CAMERA.description: The image carries metadata from a camera or an editor: it's an uploaded file, not a live capture.
IMAGE_NOT_FROM_CAMERA.message: The image doesn't come from the app's camera. Take the capture live in front of the camera.

STATIC_CAPTURE.name: Still photo
STATIC_CAPTURE.description: The captures in the attempt are identical: a real person never produces two identical frames.
STATIC_CAPTURE.message: The captures are identical, like a still photo. Stand in front of the camera and try again.

REPLAY_DETECTED.name: Reused capture
REPLAY_DETECTED.description: The capture had already been received: it's a resubmission of a saved capture.
REPLAY_DETECTED.message: This capture was already used. Take a new one in front of the camera.

CAPTURE_INCONSISTENT.name: Captures from different takes
CAPTURE_INCONSISTENT.description: The captures don't come from the same camera, or the face changed size or position in an impossible way.
CAPTURE_INCONSISTENT.message: The captures don't seem to be from the same take. Don't switch cameras or move away during the process.

VIRTUAL_CAMERA.name: Virtual camera
VIRTUAL_CAMERA.description: The camera used is a program that can stream a video or a photo instead of the real camera.
VIRTUAL_CAMERA.message: Virtual cameras aren't allowed. Use the device's camera.

CHALLENGE_TOO_FAST.name: Turn too fast
CHALLENGE_TOO_FAST.description: The capture of the head turn arrived sooner than a person takes to turn their head.
CHALLENGE_TOO_FAST.message: The turn was captured too quickly. Follow the on-screen instruction and try again.

FACE_ALREADY_REGISTERED.name: Face already enrolled
FACE_ALREADY_REGISTERED.description: The face is already enrolled as another employee of the company.
FACE_ALREADY_REGISTERED.message: This face is already enrolled as another employee of the company

FACE_LOCKED.name: Locked after attempts
FACE_LOCKED.description: Too many failed or suspicious attempts in a row.
FACE_LOCKED.message: Too many failed attempts. For security, wait {minutes} min and try again.

LOW_QUALITY.name: Insufficient quality
LOW_QUALITY.description: The capture doesn't reach the policy's minimum quality (detection, sharpness, and light).
LOW_QUALITY.message: The photo isn't good enough. Find good lighting, clean the camera, and hold still.

FLASH_MISMATCH.name: The face didn't reflect the flash
FLASH_MISMATCH.description: The colors the screen painted weren't reflected on the face: the image doesn't come from a person in front of the screen (injected or generated video).
FLASH_MISMATCH.message: Couldn't confirm that you're in front of the screen. Look straight at the camera, without filters or another camera, and try again.

FLASH_FLAT.name: Flat flash
FLASH_FLAT.message: Couldn't confirm that you're in front of the screen. Look straight at the camera, without filters or another camera, and try again.

REPLAY_PERCEPTUAL.name: Capture nearly identical to another
REPLAY_PERCEPTUAL.message: This capture was already used. Take a new one in front of the camera.

KNOWN_ATTACK.name: Known attack
KNOWN_ATTACK.message: Couldn't confirm your identity. Try again in good lighting, facing the screen.

RISK_DENIED.name: Critical risk
RISK_DENIED.message: Couldn't confirm your identity. Try again in good lighting, facing the screen.

STEP_UP_REQUIRED.name: Extra step
STEP_UP_REQUIRED.message: For security, complete one more step: follow the on-screen instructions

GLASSES.name: Possible glasses
GLASSES.description: The system detected possible glasses and the employee said they don't wear them.

HEADWEAR.name: Possible cap or hat
HEADWEAR.description: The system detected a possible cap or hat and the employee said they don't wear one.

MASK.name: Possible face mask
MASK.description: The system detected a possible face mask and the employee said they don't wear one.

SPOOF.name: Possible photo or screen
SPOOF.description: Anti-spoofing suggests the captures could be of a photo or a screen.

DUPLICATE_FACE.name: Face already enrolled for another employee
DUPLICATE_FACE.description: The face resembles another employee's approved enrollment at the company: make sure it isn't the same person with two accounts.

POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE.name: Resembles another employee
POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE.description: At the company's suspicion level, the face resembles another approved employee's: review the closest matches before approving.

PENDING.name: Pending
PENDING.description: No one has picked it up yet (or it happened again after being resolved).

IN_PROGRESS.name: In progress
IN_PROGRESS.description: Someone is working on the cause.

IN_REVIEW.name: In review
IN_REVIEW.description: The fix is done and being verified.

RESOLVED.name: Resolved
RESOLVED.description: Fixed. If it happens again, it reopens as pending on its own.

CRITICAL.name: Critical
CRITICAL.description: Unhandled failure (500) or a failure in a background process.

WARNING.name: Warning
WARNING.description: History only: rejected requests (4xx) recorded in the past. They're no longer recorded.

ON_SITE.name: On site
ON_SITE.description: Within the geofence of one of their work sites.

REMOTE.name: Remote
REMOTE.description: From anywhere, on a day the company lets them work remotely.

VALIDATOR.name: Validator
VALIDATOR.description: When identifying on a validator's tablet (counts as on site).

COMPANY.name: Recorded by the company
COMPANY.description: The company recorded or corrected it (without face or location), with its reason.

BREAK_START.name: Break start
BREAK_START.description: One of the shift's breaks begins.

OPEN.name: On shift
OPEN.description: Checked in and hasn't checked out yet.

MISSED_CHECKOUT.name: No check-out
MISSED_CHECKOUT.description: Didn't check out before the deadline.

APPROVED.name: Approved
APPROVED.description: The company approved it: it applies from the requested date (the new shift or the days off).

REJECTED.name: Rejected
REJECTED.description: The company didn't approve it (with its reason).

CANCELLED.name: Canceled
CANCELLED.description: Withdrawn by the employee (before a decision) or by the company.

SCHEDULED.name: Scheduled
SCHEDULED.description: It isn't time to check in yet.

MISSING.name: Not checked in
MISSING.description: Should have checked in already and hasn't.

ON_BREAK.name: On break
ON_BREAK.description: On one of their shift's breaks.

MISSED_CHECKOUT.name: No check-out
MISSED_CHECKOUT.description: Didn't check out before the deadline.

ABSENT.name: Absent
ABSENT.description: Their shift ended without checking in.

DAY_OFF.name: Day off
DAY_OFF.description: Doesn't work that day: holiday, vacation, leave, or sick leave (not an absence).

SCHEDULED.name: Scheduled
SCHEDULED.description: A shift change that starts later (it can be canceled before that date).

ENDED.name: Ended
ENDED.description: No longer in effect; what was recorded under it doesn't change.

VACATION.name: Vacation
VACATION.description: The employee can also request them from My attendance.

PERMISSION.name: Leave
PERMISSION.description: Time off authorized by the company; the employee can request it from My attendance.

OTHER.name: Other reason
OTHER.description: Another day off authorized and recorded by the company.

FORGOT.name: Forgot to check in or out
FORGOT.description: The employee worked but didn't record their check-in, break, or check-out.

DEVICE_FAILURE.name: Phone or camera failure
DEVICE_FAILURE.description: They couldn't record with their face because their device failed.

NO_CONNECTION.name: No connection at the site
NO_CONNECTION.description: There was no internet or location to record at that moment.

AUTHORIZED_OFFSITE.name: Authorized work away from their site
AUTHORIZED_OFFSITE.description: An assignment or visit authorized by the company away from their sites.

WRONG_RECORD.name: Wrong record
WRONG_RECORD.description: The recorded time doesn't match what actually happened.

PER_USER.name: Per active employee
PER_USER.description: Each active employee and validator, day by day (a validator counts as an employee): anyone who joins or leaves mid-period pays only for their days.

FLAT.name: Flat amount
FLAT.description: A flat amount per company, prorated by the billable days of the period.

DAY.name: Per day
DAY.description: The price is for one day.

MONTH.name: Per month
MONTH.description: The price is for one month; each day costs its prorated share.

YEAR.name: Per year
YEAR.description: The price is for one year; each day costs its prorated share.

AMOUNT.name: Flat amount
AMOUNT.description: Flat amount per charge (never more than the subtotal).

ALWAYS.name: On every charge
ALWAYS.description: The discount applies to every charge.

FIRST.name: Only on the first charges
FIRST.description: It applies to the company's first N charges.

EVERY.name: Every few charges
EVERY.description: It applies every N charges (the Nth, the 2Nth...).

SUSPENDED.name: Suspended
SUSPENDED.description: No one at the company can sign in or operate until it's reactivated.

NON_PAYMENT.name: Non-payment
NON_PAYMENT.description: Automatic: a charge remained unpaid after the grace days.

MANUAL.name: Manual suspension
MANUAL.description: Decided by the platform administrator, with their reason.

PAID.name: Paid
PAID.description: The recorded payments cover its total.

VOID.name: Voided
VOID.description: Voided with its reason: it isn't charged, and whatever was applied to it becomes a credit.

CONFIRMED.name: Confirmed
CONFIRMED.description: The payment was recorded and applied to the open charges (any excess becomes a credit).

VOID.name: Voided
VOID.description: Voided with its reason: the charges it covered become unpaid again.

TAX_CERTIFICATE.name: Tax status certificate
TAX_CERTIFICATE.description: SAT certificate with the RFC, tax regime, and tax address.

INCORPORATION.name: Articles of incorporation
INCORPORATION.description: Public deed that established the company.

PROOF_OF_ADDRESS.name: Proof of address
PROOF_OF_ADDRESS.description: Recent electricity, water, or phone bill.

REPRESENTATIVE_ID.name: Legal representative ID
REPRESENTATIVE_ID.description: Voter ID card, passport, or professional license of the person who signs for the company.

CONTRACT.name: Contract
CONTRACT.description: Service contract with the platform or another signed agreement.

MXN.name: Mexican peso
MXN.description: Mexican pesos (MXN). The platform's default currency.

USD.name: US dollar
USD.description: United States dollars (USD). For foreign customers, VAT is usually 0%.

EUR.name: Euro
EUR.description: Euros (EUR). For foreign customers, VAT is usually 0%.

PEOPLE.name: Staff
PEOPLE.description: Employees, departments, validators, and their devices.

BIOMETRICS.name: Biometrics
BIOMETRICS.description: Encrypted face templates, face enrollments, and capture fingerprints.

ATTENDANCE.name: Attendance
ATTENDANCE.description: Workdays, breaks, records, absences, and the identification log.

SECURITY.name: Sessions and security
SECURITY.description: Sign-in sessions and face attempt metrics.

BILLING.name: Billing
BILLING.description: Charges, payments, receipts, and company documents.

OPEN.name: Open
OPEN.description: No one has handled it yet (or it happened again after being resolved).

ACKNOWLEDGED.name: Acknowledged
ACKNOWLEDGED.description: Someone is already looking into it; if it happens again, it stays acknowledged.

RESOLVED.name: Resolved
RESOLVED.description: Fixed. If the route takes longer than the threshold again, it reopens on its own.

PRESENTATION.name: Presentation (photo, screen, or mask)
PRESENTATION.description: A photo, a screen, or a mask in front of the camera.

INJECTION.name: Injection (virtual camera or program)
INJECTION.description: Images that don't come from the camera: a virtual camera, a program, or a direct call to the API.

REPLAY.name: Capture resubmission
REPLAY.description: Already used captures, resubmitted with minimal changes, or artifacts of a known attack.

LOCATION.name: Fake location
LOCATION.description: A simulated or implausible location to check in from somewhere else.

BUDDY_PUNCHING.name: Buddy punching
BUDDY_PUNCHING.description: One person checks in for another: a shared account, a forwarded QR, or a remote puppet.

INTERNAL.name: Internal fraud
INTERNAL.description: Abuse from the company or a validator: enrollments approved with another person's face or unauthorized devices.

MORPH.name: Blended face (morphing)
MORPH.description: A face enrollment that mixes the features of two people.

OTHER.name: Other
OTHER.description: High risk without a clear type: the review decides.

OFF.name: Off
OFF.description: The signal isn't measured or recorded.

OBSERVE.name: Measure only
OBSERVE.description: It's measured and recorded with its points without changing the decision: use it to calibrate before requiring it.

ENFORCE.name: Required
ENFORCE.description: Its points count toward the decision; if it's a hard rule, it denies the attempt.

CAPTURE.name: Unreliable capture
CAPTURE.description: The face capture showed signs of a photo, a screen, or a video.

REPLAY.name: Repeated capture
REPLAY.description: The capture is too similar to one already received.

KNOWN_ATTACK.name: Matches a known fraud
KNOWN_ATTACK.description: The capture matches an already confirmed fraud attempt.

IDENTITY.name: Unclear identity
IDENTITY.description: The face matched with little margin or looks like another person at the company.

CAMERA.name: Unreliable camera
CAMERA.description: The camera didn't report its name or behaved like a virtual camera.

LOCATION.name: Unreliable location
LOCATION.description: The location looks simulated, changed faster than possible, or was at the edge of the site.

ACTIVITY.name: Unusual activity at the company
ACTIVITY.description: The company is receiving several suspicious attempts right now.

DEVICE.name: Unrecognized device
DEVICE.description: The record was made from a device the company hasn't approved or that couldn't be verified.

NETWORK.name: Unreliable network
NETWORK.description: The connection came from a data center or another country, or it changed suddenly.

BROWSER.name: Unreliable browser
BROWSER.description: The browser or the captures showed signs of a program instead of the app.

PRESENCE.name: Presence not confirmed
PRESENCE.description: The record didn't include the site's current code.

SPOOF_PROB_LOW.name: Low real-face probability
SPOOF_PROB_LOW.description: Anti-spoofing passed, but the real-face probability was close to its threshold.

FLASH_WEAK.name: Weak flash response
FLASH_WEAK.description: The face reflected the flash without closely following the emitted colors.

FLASH_FLAT.name: Flat flash (face same as background)
FLASH_FLAT.description: The face and the background responded the same way to the flash: typical of a screen or a photo in front of the camera.

REPLAY_PERCEPTUAL.name: Perceptual resubmission
REPLAY_PERCEPTUAL.description: A capture nearly identical (pHash and embedding) to one from a previous attempt by the same employee. A hard rule when required.

KNOWN_ATTACK.name: Known attack signature
KNOWN_ATTACK.description: The capture matches the fingerprints of a confirmed fraud at the company or on the platform. A hard rule when required.

MATCH_MARGIN_LOW.name: Narrow match
MATCH_MARGIN_LOW.description: The face matched just above the company's minimum.

CAMERA_LABEL_MISSING.name: Unnamed camera
CAMERA_LABEL_MISSING.description: The capture didn't report the camera's name: the app always sends it; a program doesn't.

LOCATION_EDGE.name: Location at the edge of the site
LOCATION_EDGE.description: The record was at the border of the site's geofence.

LOCATION_ROUND_ACCURACY.name: Round accuracy
LOCATION_ROUND_ACCURACY.description: The accuracy the device reported is a round number, typical of a simulated location.

COMPANY_UNDER_ATTACK.name: Company under attack
COMPANY_UNDER_ATTACK.description: The company has accumulated recent suspicious attempts (automatic reinforcement).

DEVICE_NEW.name: New device
DEVICE_NEW.description: The employee is checking in from a device they hadn't used or that their company hasn't approved (depending on the device mode).

DEVICE_KEY_MISSING.name: Device key missing
DEVICE_KEY_MISSING.description: The device key signature is missing or couldn't be verified: the app always sends it; a program or a private window doesn't.

DEVICE_SHARED.name: Shared device
DEVICE_SHARED.description: The same device checked in several employees of the company within a short time: typical of a coworker checking in for others.

IDENTITY_MISMATCH.name: Looks more like another employee
IDENTITY_MISMATCH.description: The face looks at least as much like another employee at the company as like the verified one (1:N on every verification): an enrollment with someone else's face, or impersonation.

NETWORK_HOSTING.name: Data center network
NETWORK_HOSTING.description: The IP belongs to a cloud or a data center (VPN, proxy, or a program), according to the local IP database.

NETWORK_COUNTRY_MISMATCH.name: Network in another country
NETWORK_COUNTRY_MISMATCH.description: The IP is from a different country than the check-in site: simulated location or VPN.

NETWORK_JUMP.name: Sudden network change
NETWORK_JUMP.description: The IP changed country or network since the previous record, faster than is plausible.

LOCATION_STATIC.name: Frozen location
LOCATION_STATIC.description: The location readings were identical (coordinates and accuracy): real GPS always varies a little; a simulator doesn't.

LOCATION_JUMP.name: Location jump
LOCATION_JUMP.description: Since the previous record, the location moved faster than anyone can comfortably travel.

AUTOMATION.name: Automated browser
AUTOMATION.description: The browser shows traces of automation (WebDriver, Playwright, Selenium, or a headless browser).

VIRTUAL_CAMERA_PRESENT.name: Virtual camera installed
VIRTUAL_CAMERA_PRESENT.description: The device has a virtual camera (OBS, ManyCam…) even if the capture didn't use it.

TRACK_INCONSISTENT.name: Inconsistent camera
TRACK_INCONSISTENT.description: The camera reported a resolution or frame rate beyond what it says it supports, or it has no identifier.

FRAME_TIMING_SYNTHETIC.name: Synthetic video timing
FRAME_TIMING_SYNTHETIC.description: The frames arrived at an exact pace, without the variation of a real camera: typical of a video or a virtual camera.

SCREEN_INCOHERENT.name: Inconsistent screen
SCREEN_INCOHERENT.description: The screen doesn't match the device it claims to be (a phone without a touch screen or with a desktop screen) or has no dimensions.

TELEMETRY_MISSING.name: Capture telemetry missing
TELEMETRY_MISSING.description: The telemetry the app always sends is missing or malformed: typical of a program calling the API.

JPEG_TABLE_UNKNOWN.name: Image from another encoder
JPEG_TABLE_UNKNOWN.description: The captures don't have the app's JPEG tables: another program produced them or images from different sources were mixed.

BURST_MISSING.name: Capture burst missing
BURST_MISSING.description: The burst of crops the app always sends is missing or damaged. It usually points to a program calling the API.

BURST_DISCONTINUOUS.name: Discontinuous burst
BURST_DISCONTINUOUS.description: The crops don't follow one face: there are jumps, crops without a face, or another person. It usually points to edited footage.

BURST_FROZEN.name: Frozen image
BURST_FROZEN.description: The burst barely changed between crops. A real camera always has noise and motion; a still image doesn't.

BURST_LOOP.name: Looped video
BURST_LOOP.description: The burst repeated identical frames. A real camera never repeats its noise; a looped video does.

MOIRE_HIGH.name: Screen pattern
MOIRE_HIGH.description: The face shows the pixel pattern of a photographed screen.

NOISE_MISMATCH.name: Inconsistent sensor noise
NOISE_MISMATCH.description: The face is much smoother than the background of the same capture. It usually points to a pasted, generated, or recaptured face.

PERSPECTIVE_FLAT.name: Flat-surface motion
PERSPECTIVE_FLAT.description: When turning, the face moved like a flat surface, without the nose's perspective. It usually points to a tilted photo.

PULSE_ABSENT.name: No visible pulse (measured only)
PULSE_ABSENT.description: The burst didn't show the skin's color change with the heartbeat. It's measured only and never decides: it often fails in low light or with motion.

FLASH_UNPACED.name: Flash not paced
FLASH_UNPACED.description: The flash colors weren't paced live, so they could be prepared in advance. It also happens on networks that block the live channel.

FLASH_PACE_TIMING.name: Flash out of time
FLASH_PACE_TIMING.description: A paced flash color was answered outside its window, too slow or too fast.

FLASH_PACE_MISMATCH.name: Tampered flash
FLASH_PACE_MISMATCH.description: The flash captures don't match the ones sent live, or their receipt isn't valid. Only a tampered app produces this.

VALIDATOR_UNSIGNED.name: Identification without device signature
VALIDATOR_UNSIGNED.description: The validator's identification didn't include its device signature, or its challenge had expired. The app always signs; a program using a copied token doesn't.

VALIDATOR_SIGNATURE_INVALID.name: Tampered device signature
VALIDATOR_SIGNATURE_INVALID.description: The identification's signature doesn't match its challenge or its content. Only a tampered app or an attack produces it. Hard rule when required.

VALIDATOR_KEY_MISMATCH.name: Device differs from the session's
VALIDATOR_KEY_MISMATCH.description: A device other than the one that signed in signed the identification: typical of a token copied to another device. It also happens if the browser cleared its key.

VALIDATOR_LOCATION_MISSING.name: Identification without location
VALIDATOR_LOCATION_MISSING.description: The validator requires location and the identification didn't include it: the permission was revoked or the request didn't come from the app.

VALIDATOR_LOCATION_INACCURATE.name: Inaccurate validator location
VALIDATOR_LOCATION_INACCURATE.description: The identification's location is too imprecise to tell whether the validator is at its place.

VALIDATOR_OUT_OF_ZONE.name: Validator away from its place
VALIDATOR_OUT_OF_ZONE.description: The identification happened far from where the validator operates: a tablet taken off-site or a token used elsewhere.

SITE_CODE_MISSING.name: Record without site code
SITE_CODE_MISSING.description: The site asks for its code and the record didn't include it.

SITE_CODE_INVALID.name: Invalid site code
SITE_CODE_INVALID.description: The code isn't the site's current one: it expired, belongs to another site, or was already used. It often means someone passed it on from the site.

MEDIUM.name: Medium
MEDIUM.description: Some signals: by default it asks for one more step.

HIGH.name: High
HIGH.description: Strong signals: by default the record goes under review and a case is opened.

CRITICAL.name: Critical
CRITICAL.description: Very strong signals: by default it's denied, counts toward the lockout, and a case is opened.

ALERT.name: Allow and alert
ALERT.description: The attempt continues, but a case is opened for the admin to review.

STEP_UP.name: One more step
STEP_UP.description: A tougher challenge (three movements and a required flash) is requested on the spot, without repeating the scan.

REVIEW.name: Under review
REVIEW.description: It's recorded, but the company must confirm or reject it; a case is opened.

DENY.name: Deny
DENY.description: The attempt is rejected (it counts toward the temporary lockout) and a case is opened.

PENDING.name: Under review
PENDING.description: The record was saved, but the company must confirm or reject it.

CONFIRMED.name: Confirmed
CONFIRMED.description: The company confirmed the record is valid.

REJECTED.name: Rejected
REJECTED.description: The company rejected the record: it wasn't made by the employee or at the right place.

OBSERVE.name: Measure only
OBSERVE.description: It records which device each employee checks in from; a new one or one without a key is only noted as a signal.

STEP_UP.name: One more step on a new device
STEP_UP.description: A new device asks for one more step (a tougher challenge); once passed, it becomes trusted.

APPROVAL.name: Company approval
APPROVAL.description: Until the company approves a new device, the records made from it stay under review.

STANDARD.name: Standard
STANDARD.description: For most companies: two movements in 60 s, Standard anti-spoofing, and risk cutoffs 30/60/80. The flash (until calibrated), the employee's device, the capture protocol, and validator presence stay in Measure only.

HIGH.name: High
HIGH.description: Stricter: three movements in 45 s, required flash, High anti-spoofing, required perceptual resubmission check, one more step on a new device, and cutoffs 25/50/75. The capture protocol and validator presence stay in Measure only.

MAXIMUM.name: Maximum
MAXIMUM.description: For confirmed fraud: three movements in 30 s, Maximum anti-spoofing, required hard rules, the company approves each device, and high risk is denied. Requires the paced flash and burst (if missing, one more step), validator signing and location, and site codes. More retries in low light.

APPLIED.name: Applied
APPLIED.description: The change is already in effect.

PENDING.name: Awaiting approval
PENDING.description: It lowers security: it's waiting for another admin's approval.

REJECTED.name: Rejected
REJECTED.description: Another admin rejected it: it wasn't applied.

CANCELLED.name: Canceled
CANCELLED.description: Whoever requested it withdrew it, or it expired without approval.

CONFIRMED.name: Fraud confirmed
CONFIRMED.description: The fraud was confirmed: its fingerprints go to the block list and what was learned since the attempt is forgotten.

FALSE_POSITIVE.name: False positive
FALSE_POSITIVE.description: It wasn't fraud: its fingerprints are released and the case helps calibrate.

INCONCLUSIVE.name: Inconclusive
INCONCLUSIVE.description: There isn't enough to decide: it only counts for the statistics.

OPENED.name: Case opened
OPENED.description: The system opened the case for a suspicious or high-risk attempt.

STATUS_CHANGED.name: Status changed
STATUS_CHANGED.description: An admin changed the case status.

EVIDENCE_VIEWED.name: Evidence viewed
EVIDENCE_VIEWED.description: An admin viewed the evidence frames.

SIGNATURES_BLOCKED.name: Fingerprints blocked
SIGNATURES_BLOCKED.description: The attack's fingerprints were added to the block list.

SIGNATURES_RELEASED.name: Fingerprints released
SIGNATURES_RELEASED.description: The case's fingerprints were removed from the block list.

LEARNING_FORGOTTEN.name: Learning forgotten
LEARNING_FORGOTTEN.description: What the recognition learned about the employee since the attempt was forgotten.

BUSINESS.name: Business
BUSINESS.description: Company billing and their platform usage.

OPERATIONS.name: Operations
OPERATIONS.description: System health: errors, performance, and server status.

PEOPLE.name: Staff
PEOPLE.description: Employees, departments, and the validation of their face enrollments.

ATTENDANCE.name: Attendance
ATTENDANCE.description: Board, shifts, days-off calendar, and sites.

ACCESS.name: Access control
ACCESS.description: Validators that identify employees at an entrance.

DATA.name: Connections
DATA.description: Connections to the company's other systems (payroll, ERP).

MY_WORK.name: My work
MY_WORK.description: Check-in, breaks, and check-out for their shift.

IDENTITY.name: My identity
IDENTITY.description: Face enrollment, identification, and QR code.

ACCOUNT.name: Account
ACCOUNT.description: The company they work in and their profile.

ADMIN_COMPANIES.name: Companies
ADMIN_COMPANIES.description: Add and manage companies and their administrators.

ADMIN_ERRORS.name: System errors
ADMIN_ERRORS.description: Server and web app failures and their follow-up.

ADMIN_FACE_SECURITY.name: Face security
ADMIN_FACE_SECURITY.description: Automatic liveness check adjustments, companies under attack, and flash measurements.

ADMIN_FRAUD_CASES.name: Fraud cases
ADMIN_FRAUD_CASES.description: Review of suspicious or high-risk attempts with their evidence.

ADMIN_BILLING.name: Billing
ADMIN_BILLING.description: Each company's plan, charges, payments, and balance; suspension for non-payment and reactivation.

ADMIN_USAGE.name: Usage
ADMIN_USAGE.description: Requests, data, processing time, errors, and storage per company and per user.

ADMIN_PERFORMANCE.name: Performance
ADMIN_PERFORMANCE.description: Response times for APIs, key functions, the database, and screens; slow request alerts.

COMPANY_DASHBOARD.name: Dashboard
COMPANY_DASHBOARD.description: Company summary: employees and pending validations.

COMPANY_EMPLOYEES.name: Employees
COMPANY_EMPLOYEES.description: Add, view, and edit the company's employees.

COMPANY_DEPARTMENTS.name: Departments
COMPANY_DEPARTMENTS.description: The company's departments with their managers and assigned employees.

COMPANY_ATTENDANCE.name: Daily board
COMPANY_ATTENDANCE.description: Who's on shift, on break, or already checked out; workday history with its evidence.

COMPANY_SHIFTS.name: Shifts
COMPANY_SHIFTS.description: Shifts, their assignment to employees, and change requests.

COMPANY_CALENDAR.name: Calendar
COMPANY_CALENDAR.description: Holidays, vacations, leaves, and sick leaves.

COMPANY_SITES.name: Work sites
COMPANY_SITES.description: Branches and plants with their geofence: where people check in on site.

COMPANY_VALIDATORS.name: Validators
COMPANY_VALIDATORS.description: Tablets or phones that identify employees at an entrance.

COMPANY_API.name: Integrations (API)
COMPANY_API.description: API keys to connect other systems (payroll, ERP).

COMPANY_DOCUMENTS.name: Documents
COMPANY_DOCUMENTS.description: Company documents for invoicing: tax status certificate, articles of incorporation, and more.

VALIDATOR_CHECKPOINT.name: Identify employees
VALIDATOR_CHECKPOINT.description: Checkpoint: identifies employees by face or QR.

EMPLOYEE_ATTENDANCE.name: My attendance
EMPLOYEE_ATTENDANCE.description: Check-in, breaks, and check-out with face and location; vacation and leave.

EMPLOYEE_ENROLL.name: Face enrollment
EMPLOYEE_ENROLL.description: The employee enrolls their face (not enrolled yet or rejected).

EMPLOYEE_PENDING.name: Face enrollment
EMPLOYEE_PENDING.description: The employee's face enrollment is waiting for the company's validation.

EMPLOYEE_VERIFY.name: Identification
EMPLOYEE_VERIFY.description: The employee identifies with their face or their QR code.

EMPLOYEE_QR.name: My QR code
EMPLOYEE_QR.description: The employee's QR badge (only with an approved identity).

EMPLOYEE_SELECT_COMPANY.name: Switch company
EMPLOYEE_SELECT_COMPANY.description: For people who work at several companies: choose which one to enter.
